title: Modul HRD - Work Schedule Management - Panduan Lengkap
description: Panduan lengkap menggunakan Work Schedule Management dalam sistem HRD GIMS mencakup pembuatan jadwal kerja, konfigurasi jam kerja, pengaturan GPS, toleransi keterlambatan, dan manajemen waktu istirahat.
author: Tim GIMS

content.body: Modul Work Schedule Management mengelola jadwal kerja karyawan dengan fleksibilitas tinggi. Mendukung jam kerja tetap (fixed hours) dan fleksibel (flexible hours), pengaturan GPS untuk validasi lokasi kantor, konfigurasi toleransi keterlambatan, dan multiple break times. Jadwal kerja menjadi basis untuk tracking attendance, validasi check-in/out, dan perhitungan overtime.

items.title: Fixed Hours Schedule
items.body: Jadwal kerja tetap dengan jam masuk & pulang yang jelas (e.g., 08:00-17:00)

items.title: Flexible Hours Schedule
items.body: Jadwal fleksibel dengan range jam masuk & pulang (e.g., masuk 07:00-10:00)

items.title: GPS Validation
items.body: Validasi lokasi check-in/out berdasarkan koordinat GPS kantor & radius tertentu

items.title: Working Days Bitmask
items.body: Konfigurasi hari kerja fleksibel (Monday-Friday, Monday-Saturday, custom)

items.title: Break Times
items.body: Multiple break periods dengan waktu mulai & berakhir yang bisa dikustomisasi

items.title: Tolerance Settings
items.body: Grace period untuk keterlambatan & pulang lebih awal (e.g., toleransi 10 menit)

items.title: Buka Menu HRD
items.body: Pada sidebar aplikasi, klik menu HRD untuk melihat submenu yang tersedia.

items.title: Pilih Submenu Work Schedules
items.body: Dari submenu HRD, klik Work Schedules untuk membuka halaman manajemen jadwal kerja.

items.title: Membuat Jadwal Kerja (Fixed Hours)
items.body:
Jadwal kerja fixed hours adalah jadwal dengan jam masuk & pulang yang tetap untuk setiap hari kerja.

---

CARA MEMBUAT FIXED HOURS SCHEDULE:

1. Buka Work Schedules → + Create New Schedule
2. Isi informasi dasar:
   
   Schedule Details:
   - Schedule Name: "Standard Office Hours"
   - Description: "Jadwal kerja standar kantor, Senin-Jumat"
   - Is Default: ✓ (jadwal default untuk karyawan baru)
   - Is Active: ✓ (schedule aktif)
   - Division: "IT/Engineering" (optional - untuk divisi tertentu)
   
3. Konfigurasi jam kerja:
   
   Work Hours:
   - Schedule Type: Fixed Hours ← Pilih ini
   - Start Time: 08:00 (jam masuk)
   - End Time: 17:00 (jam pulang)
   - Working Hours Per Day: 8 hours (auto-calculated)
   
4. Atur hari kerja:
   
   Working Days:
   - Monday: ✓ (aktif)
   - Tuesday: ✓
   - Wednesday: ✓
   - Thursday: ✓
   - Friday: ✓
   - Saturday: ☐ (tidak aktif)
   - Sunday: ☐ (tidak aktif)
   - Shortcut: "Mon-Fri" (akan check otomatis)
   
5. Konfigurasi istirahat:
   
   Break Times:
   - Tambah Break #1:
     * Start Time: 12:00
     * End Time: 13:00
     * Duration: 1 hour
   - Tambah Break #2 (optional):
     * Start Time: 15:00
     * End Time: 15:15
     * Duration: 15 minutes
   
   Total Break Duration: 1 hour 15 minutes
   Actual Working Hours: 8 hours - 1h 15m = 6h 45m
   
6. Toleransi keterlambatan:
   
   Tolerance Settings:
   - Late Tolerance: 10 minutes (grace period untuk terlambat)
   - Early Leave Tolerance: 5 minutes (grace period untuk pulang lebih awal)
   
   Contoh:
   - Karyawan check-in 08:05 (5 menit terlambat) → OK (dalam tolerance)
   - Karyawan check-in 08:15 (15 menit terlambat) → TERLAMBAT (exceeds tolerance)
   - Karyawan check-out 16:55 (5 menit awal) → OK
   - Karyawan check-out 16:50 (10 menit awal) → PULANG AWAL
   
7. Konfigurasi GPS (optional):
   
   GPS Configuration:
   - Require GPS: ☐ (tidak wajib GPS untuk schedule ini)
   - (jika diaktifkan:)
     * GPS Radius: 100 meters (radius dari kantor)
     * Company: "Jakarta Pusat" (untuk auto-populate GPS)
     * Office Latitude: -6.2088 (auto-populate)
     * Office Longitude: 106.8456 (auto-populate)
   
   Fungsi GPS:
   - Validasi lokasi check-in/out
   - Pastikan karyawan berada di kantor saat clock in
   - Prevent fraud (fake check-in dari lokasi jauh)
   
8. Klik Create
9. Status: ACTIVE (jadwal siap digunakan)
10. Dapat diassign ke employees via Employee module

---

EXAMPLE FIXED SCHEDULES:

1. Standard Office Hours
   - Start: 08:00, End: 17:00
   - Working Days: Mon-Fri
   - Break: 12:00-13:00 (1 hour)
   - Total: 8 hours/day
   - Use Case: Regular office staff

2. Early Morning Shift
   - Start: 06:00, End: 15:00
   - Working Days: Mon-Fri
   - Break: 10:00-10:30 (30 min), 12:00-13:00 (1 hour)
   - Total: 8 hours/day
   - Use Case: Warehouse staff, early start

3. Evening Shift
   - Start: 14:00, End: 23:00
   - Working Days: Mon-Fri
   - Break: 17:00-18:00 (1 hour), 20:00-20:30 (30 min)
   - Total: 8 hours/day
   - Use Case: Customer service night shift

4. Night Shift
   - Start: 22:00, End: 07:00 (next day)
   - Working Days: Mon-Fri
   - Break: 01:00-02:00 (1 hour), 04:00-04:30 (30 min)
   - Total: 8 hours/day
   - Use Case: Factory, security, 24/7 operations

5. Part-time (4 hours)
   - Start: 14:00, End: 18:00
   - Working Days: Mon-Fri
   - Break: None (short shift)
   - Total: 4 hours/day
   - Use Case: Part-time employees

---

BEST PRACTICES:

✓ Clear naming ("Standard Office Hours" bukan "Schedule A")
✓ Realistic timing (sesuai operasi bisnis)
✓ Reasonable tolerance (biasanya 5-15 menit)
✓ Multiple breaks (untuk comfort & regulation compliance)
✓ Set one as default (untuk onboarding consistency)
✓ Active flag (deactivate old schedules)
✓ Documentation (deskripsi untuk clarity)

items.title: Membuat Jadwal Kerja (Flexible Hours)
items.body:
Jadwal kerja flexible hours memungkinkan karyawan memilih jam masuk dalam range tertentu, dengan requirement jam kerja tetap.

---

KAPAN GUNAKAN FLEXIBLE HOURS:

- Remote/hybrid work (karyawan work from home)
- Professional roles (developer, analyst, designer)
- Results-oriented jobs (outcome more important than presence)
- Retention tool (attract talent with flexibility)
- Commute consideration (flexible to avoid rush hour)

CONTOH SKENARIO:

Karyawan dapat memilih:
- Masuk 07:00-10:00 (range 3 jam)
- Pulang 16:00-19:00 (range 3 jam)
- Total kerja tetap 8 jam/hari

Opsi:
- Masuk 07:00 → Pulang 16:00 (8 jam)
- Masuk 09:00 → Pulang 18:00 (8 jam)
- Masuk 10:00 → Pulang 19:00 (8 jam)

---

CARA MEMBUAT FLEXIBLE HOURS SCHEDULE:

1. Buka Work Schedules → + Create New Schedule
2. Isi informasi dasar:
   
   Schedule Details:
   - Schedule Name: "Flexible Working Hours"
   - Description: "Jadwal kerja fleksibel, cocok untuk WFH/hybrid"
   - Division: "IT/Engineering"
   - Is Active: ✓
   
3. Konfigurasi jam kerja:
   
   Work Hours:
   - Schedule Type: Flexible Hours ← Pilih ini
   - Flexible Start Time: 07:00 (jam masuk tercepat)
   - Flexible End Time: 10:00 (jam masuk terakhir)
   - Start Time (requirement): 08:00 (jam "standard" untuk reporting)
   - End Time (requirement): 17:00 (jam "standard" untuk reporting)
   - Total Working Hours Per Day: 8 hours (tetap)
   
   Interpretasi:
   - Karyawan boleh check-in 07:00-10:00
   - Karyawan harus total 8 jam kerja
   - Jika masuk 07:00 → pulang 15:00
   - Jika masuk 10:00 → pulang 18:00
   - Start/End time "standard" untuk dokumentasi
   
4. Hari kerja, break, tolerance, GPS sama seperti fixed hours
   
5. Contoh konfigurasi lengkap:
   
   Schedule Type: Flexible Hours
   Flexible Start Time: 07:00
   Flexible End Time: 10:00
   Flexible Clock-Out Range: 15:00-19:00 (optional)
   Total Hours: 8 hours
   
   Break:
   - 12:00-13:00 (1 hour)
   - 15:00-15:15 (15 min)
   
   Working Days: Mon-Fri
   Tolerance: 10 min late, 5 min early leave
   GPS: Optional (biasanya tidak untuk flexible)
   
6. Klik Create
7. Status: ACTIVE

---

FLEXIBLE VS FIXED COMPARISON:

| Aspek | Fixed | Flexible |
|-------|-------|----------|
| Jam masuk | Tetap (08:00) | Range (07:00-10:00) |
| Jam pulang | Tetap (17:00) | Range (15:00-19:00) |
| Total kerja | 8 jam/hari | 8 jam/hari |
| Kontrol | Ketat (presence) | Fleksibel (results) |
| Monitoring | Attendance-based | Output-based |
| GPS | Sering | Jarang |
| Best for | Office roles | Remote/Professional |

---

EXAMPLE FLEXIBLE SCHEDULES:

1. Flexible 07:00-10:00 Start
   - Earliest: 07:00
   - Latest: 10:00
   - Total: 8 hours
   - Latest depart: 19:00
   - Use Case: Flexible commute, hybrid work

2. Ultra Flexible 06:00-14:00 Start
   - Earliest: 06:00
   - Latest: 14:00
   - Total: 8 hours
   - Latest depart: 22:00
   - Use Case: Very flexible workplace, remote-heavy

3. Core Hours + Flexible
   - Core hours: 09:00-12:00, 14:00-16:00 (4 hours fixed)
   - Flexible: 07:00-09:00 (2 hour window before core)
   - Need 2 more hours after 16:00
   - Total: 8 hours
   - Use Case: Collaboration required + flexibility

---

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE BEST PRACTICES:

✓ Clear range window (don't make it too wide/confusing)
✓ Total hours still defined (not "work whenever")
✓ Core hours concept (if team coordination needed)
✓ Output metrics clear (since presence is flexible)
✓ Trust-based culture (requires manager maturity)
✓ Document in policy (clear expectations)
✓ Timezone consideration (if distributed team)

items.title: Konfigurasi GPS Validation
items.body:
GPS Validation memastikan karyawan check-in dari lokasi yang valid (kantor) dengan mengecek koordinat GPS & radius dari kantor.

---

KAPAN GUNAKAN GPS VALIDATION:

- Office-based roles (harus di kantor)
- Mobile staff (field sales, delivery)
- Security-conscious (prevent fraud check-in)
- Multi-location company (branch validation)
- Hybrid offices (validate correct branch)

TIDON PERLU GPS:

- Full remote team (work from home)
- Trust-based culture (small company)
- Work from anywhere policy
- Results-only work environment

---

CARA SETUP GPS VALIDATION:

1. Persiapan: Dapatkan koordinat GPS kantor
   
   Option A: Manual input
   - Gunakan Google Maps: search alamat kantor
   - Klik lokasi → lihat latitude & longitude
   - Contoh: Jakarta Pusat
     * Latitude: -6.2088
     * Longitude: 106.8456
   
   Option B: Auto-populate dari Company master
   - Pastikan Company data sudah set GPS
   - Saat create schedule, select Company → coordinates auto-fill
   
2. Edit/Create Work Schedule
3. Enable GPS:
   
   GPS Configuration:
   - Require GPS: ✓ (aktifkan GPS validation)
   - GPS Radius: 100 meters (radius dari kantor)
   - Company: "PT ABC Jakarta" ← Select company dengan GPS
   - Office Latitude: -6.2088 (auto-populate)
   - Office Longitude: 106.8456 (auto-populate)
   
   Interpretasi:
   - Karyawan harus dalam radius 100 meter dari kantor
   - Jika lebih jauh → check-in ditolak (FAILED_GPS_VALIDATION)
   - Grace: biasanya ± 10 meter toleransi
   
4. Radius setting guidance:
   
   | Radius | Use Case |
   |--------|----------|
   | 50 m | Strict (hanya kantor area) |
   | 100 m | Standard (kantor + parking) |
   | 200 m | Loose (kantor + surrounding) |
   | 500 m | Very loose (entire building complex) |
   | 1000 m | Multi-location (campus with buildings) |
   
5. GPS workflow untuk karyawan:
   
   Employee Check-in Process:
   - Open GIMS mobile app (atau web)
   - Click "Check In"
   - System request GPS permission
   - Detect current location
   - Calculate distance to office (100m configured)
   
   Scenarios:
   - At office (10m away): ✓ Check-in allowed
   - In parking (80m away): ✓ Check-in allowed (< 100m)
   - In cafe nearby (150m away): ✗ Check-in denied (> 100m)
     * Error: "You are 150 meters away from office. Minimum distance: 100m"
   - At home (5km away): ✗ Check-in denied
   - GPS disabled: ✗ Check-in denied (no location)
   
6. Troubleshooting GPS issues:
   
   Problem: "GPS not accurate"
   Solution: 
   - Increase radius to 150-200m
   - Enable "fuzzy matching" (if available)
   - Verify Company GPS coordinates correct
   - Test with known-good location
   
   Problem: "GPS kept failing for certain area"
   Solution:
   - May be GPS dead zone (underground, building blocked)
   - Consider WiFi-based location (instead of GPS)
   - Use wider radius
   - Exempt remote workers from GPS
   
   Problem: "Radius too strict"
   Solution:
   - Increase from 50m to 100m or 200m
   - Consider parking area vs. office entrance
   - Survey actual distances
   
7. Multi-location GPS:
   
   Jika perusahaan punya multiple kantor:
   
   Schedule A (Jakarta):
   - Company: "Jakarta Pusat"
   - GPS: -6.2088, 106.8456
   - Radius: 100m
   
   Schedule B (Bandung):
   - Company: "Bandung Office"
   - GPS: -6.9271, 107.6411
   - Radius: 100m
   
   Karyawan assign ke schedule sesuai lokasi:
   - Jakarta team → Schedule A (Jakarta GPS)
   - Bandung team → Schedule B (Bandung GPS)
   
---

GPS BEST PRACTICES:

✓ Reasonable radius (100-200m typical)
✓ Tested location (verify GPS works there)
✓ Clear communication (employees know GPS required)
✓ Mobile-friendly (GPS in app, not just web)
✓ Parking consideration (include parking in radius)
✓ Building entrance clear (not basement)
✓ Fallback plan (if GPS fails, alternative check-in)
✓ Privacy respected (only during check-in, not tracking)

items.title: Manajemen Tolerance & Keterlambatan
items.body:
Tolerance Setting mengatur grace period untuk keterlambatan & pulang lebih awal, dengan tujuan fairness dan flexibility.

---

TOLERANCE JENIS:

1. Late Tolerance (Toleransi Keterlambatan)
   - Grace period untuk terlambat
   - Contoh: 10 menit toleransi
   - Karyawan yang terlambat <= 10 menit: NOT LATE
   - Karyawan yang terlambat > 10 menit: LATE

2. Early Leave Tolerance (Toleransi Pulang Awal)
   - Grace period untuk pulang awal
   - Contoh: 5 menit toleransi
   - Karyawan pulang 5 menit sebelum jam: NORMAL
   - Karyawan pulang 10 menit sebelum jam: EARLY LEAVE

---

CARA SETUP TOLERANCE:

1. Edit Work Schedule
2. Scroll ke "Tolerance Settings"
3. Isi:
   
   Tolerance Settings:
   - Late Tolerance Minutes: 10
   - Early Leave Tolerance Minutes: 5
   
4. Klik Update
5. Status: Active

---

EXAMPLE CALCULATION:

Schedule: 08:00-17:00
Tolerance: 10 min late, 5 min early

Check-in Scenarios:

08:05 (5 min late)
- vs tolerance (10 min): 5 < 10 ✓ NOT LATE
- Status: ON TIME

08:12 (12 min late)
- vs tolerance (10 min): 12 > 10 ✗ LATE
- Status: LATE (2 minutes over tolerance)
- Record: Late by 12 min

08:00 exactly
- Status: ON TIME

07:55 (5 min early)
- Status: EARLY CHECK-IN (allowed, for eager workers)

Check-out Scenarios:

16:55 (5 min early)
- vs tolerance (5 min): 5 = 5 ✓ ON TIME
- Status: ON TIME

16:50 (10 min early)
- vs tolerance (5 min): 10 > 5 ✗ EARLY LEAVE
- Status: EARLY LEAVE (5 minutes over tolerance)
- Record: Left 10 min early

17:00 exactly
- Status: ON TIME

17:05 (5 min late)
- Status: OVERTIME (working extra)

---

TOLERANCE GUIDELINES:

| Industry | Late Tolerance | Early Leave |
|----------|----------------|-------------|
| Strict (Finance, Admin) | 5-10 min | 0-5 min |
| Standard (Office, IT) | 10-15 min | 5-10 min |
| Flexible (Remote-based) | 15-30 min | 10-15 min |
| Very Flexible (Results-only) | 30+ min | 30+ min |

---

TOLERANCE POLICY FRAMEWORK:

1. First Offense
   - 1 late (within month): Verbal warning
   - Track for pattern

2. Pattern Recognition
   - 3 times late in month: Coaching
   - 5+ times in month: Written warning

3. Discipline
   - Persistent pattern: Further action per policy
   - Document all incidents

4. Fairness
   - Apply same tolerance to all
   - No favoritism
   - Transparent communication

---

SYSTEM CALCULATION:

When employee check-in:

1. Get check-in time from mobile
2. Get schedule from employee's assigned schedule
3. Calculate difference:
   - Difference = Check-in Time - Scheduled Start Time
4. Compare with tolerance:
   - If Difference <= Tolerance: "ON TIME" ✓
   - If Difference > Tolerance: "LATE" with duration
5. Record in Attendance

Same logic for check-out vs Early Leave Tolerance

---

BEST PRACTICES:

✓ Reasonable tolerance (not too strict, not too loose)
✓ Consistent application (same for all)
✓ Clear communication (employees know tolerance)
✓ Progressive discipline (coaching before penalties)
✓ Tracking system (automated in GIMS)
✓ Exceptions handled (approved absences don't count)
✓ Regular review (adjust if needed)

items.title: Assign Schedule ke Employee
items.body:
Setelah work schedule dibuat, assign ke employee agar schedule mereka tercatat di system untuk attendance tracking.

---

CARA ASSIGN SCHEDULE KE EMPLOYEE:

1. Buka Employee module
2. Cari employee: "Budi Santoso"
3. Buka employee detail
4. Scroll ke "Work Schedule" section
5. Click "Change Schedule"
6. Dialog muncul:
   
   Select Work Schedule:
   - Current Schedule: "Standard Office Hours" (existing)
   - Change to: "Flexible Working Hours"
   - Effective Date: 01/05/2026 (mulai kapan)
   - Reason: "Employee transitioned to hybrid work"
   
7. Click "Save"
8. Schedule updated untuk employee
9. Effective mulai tanggal yang ditentukan

---

SCENARIO ASSIGN SCHEDULE:

Scenario 1: New Employee Onboarding

- Budi hired sebagai Senior Developer
- Default schedule: "Standard Office Hours"
- Buka Budi's employee record
- Work Schedule auto-set ke "Standard Office Hours"
- Start date: 01/06/2026
- Attendance tracking mulai 01/06

Scenario 2: Transition dari Fixed ke Flexible

- Citra = IT Support, fixed schedule
- Sekarang approved untuk remote work
- Change schedule: Fixed Hours → Flexible Hours
- Effective: 01/05/2026
- Attendance tracking adjust to flexible policy

Scenario 3: Shift Change

- Ahmad = warehouse staff, early morning shift (06:00-15:00)
- Transfer ke evening shift team
- Change schedule: Early Shift → Evening Shift (14:00-23:00)
- Effective: 15/05/2026
- Check-in/out validation change otomatis

Scenario 4: Division-Based Schedule

- Divide company into 2 divisions:
  * Division A: "Sales" → "Standard Hours" (08:00-17:00)
  * Division B: "Engineering" → "Flexible Hours" (07:00-10:00 start)
- New employee in Sales → auto assign "Standard Hours"
- New employee in Engineering → auto assign "Flexible Hours"
- Bulk assign via employee batch import

---

BULK ASSIGN SCHEDULES:

(If system supports batch operations)

1. Buka Employee → Bulk Operations
2. Select multiple employees:
   - Budi Santoso
   - Citra Wijaya
   - Ahmad Rahman
   (20 employees total)
3. Action: "Change Work Schedule"
4. New Schedule: "Flexible Working Hours"
5. Effective Date: 01/06/2026
6. Click "Apply"
7. All 20 employees updated simultaneously
8. Confirmation: "20 employees updated successfully"

---

CHECK-IN/OUT VALIDATION BASED ON SCHEDULE:

Once schedule assigned, attendance system uses it for validation:

Budi assigned "Standard Office Hours" (08:00-17:00, 10 min tolerance):

- 08:05 check-in: ✓ ON TIME (within tolerance)
- 08:15 check-in: ✗ LATE (exceeds tolerance)
- 17:00 check-out: ✓ ON TIME
- 16:55 check-out: ✓ ON TIME (within 5 min tolerance)
- 16:45 check-out: ✗ EARLY LEAVE

Citra assigned "Flexible Working Hours" (07:00-10:00 start range):

- 07:30 check-in: ✓ VALID (within flexible range)
- 09:45 check-in: ✓ VALID (within range)
- 10:15 check-in: ✗ INVALID (outside flexible range)
- Must work total 8 hours per day

---

CHANGE HISTORY:

System track all schedule changes:

Budi's Schedule History:
- 01/06/2026: "Standard Office Hours" (on hire)
- 01/09/2026: "Flexible Working Hours" (change to hybrid)
- 01/01/2027: "Standard Office Hours" (back to office)

For audit trail & compliance documentation.

---

BEST PRACTICES:

✓ Assign on hire (immediately in onboarding)
✓ Effective date clear (start date of change)
✓ Document reason (for HR record)
✓ Notify employee (communicate changes)
✓ System validates correctly (test check-in after change)
✓ Change tracking (audit history)
✓ Review regularly (adjust if needs change)

items.title: Skenario 1: Setup Multiple Schedules untuk Company
items.body:
PT ABC Indonesia (perusahaan multidivisional) butuh setup 5 jadwal kerja berbeda sesuai kebutuhan divisional.

PT ABC Organization:
- IT/Engineering Division (remote-friendly)
- Sales Division (office-based)
- Operations/Warehouse (shift-based)
- Customer Service (multi-shift)
- Management (flexible executive)

Week 1-2: Planning & Analysis

- HR meeting with department heads
- Understand work patterns:
  * IT: flexible hours, hybrid work
  * Sales: office presence (client meetings)
  * Warehouse: early shift (5:00 AM start)
  * CS: multiple shifts (24/7 coverage)
  * Mgmt: flexible hours

Week 3: Create Work Schedules

1. Standard Office Hours (Sales)
   - 08:00-17:00
   - Mon-Fri
   - Break: 12:00-13:00 (1h)
   - Tolerance: 10min late, 5min early
   - GPS: None (office staff)
   - Active: ✓

2. Flexible Work Hours (IT)
   - Flexible start: 07:00-10:00
   - Total: 8 hours
   - Mon-Fri
   - Break: 12:00-13:00, 15:00-15:15
   - Tolerance: 15min late, 10min early
   - GPS: None (remote-friendly)
   - Active: ✓

3. Early Morning Shift (Warehouse)
   - 05:00-14:00
   - Mon-Fri
   - Break: 08:00-08:30, 11:00-12:00 (1.5h total)
   - Total: 8 hours
   - Tolerance: 10min late, 5min early
   - GPS: ✓ Required (warehouse location)
   - Active: ✓

4. Afternoon Shift (Customer Service)
   - 13:00-22:00
   - Mon-Fri, Sat optional
   - Break: 15:00-16:00, 19:00-19:30 (1.5h)
   - Total: 8 hours
   - Tolerance: 10min late, 5min early
   - GPS: None
   - Active: ✓

5. Night Shift (Customer Service)
   - 22:00-07:00 (next day)
   - Mon-Fri, rotating
   - Break: 01:00-02:00, 04:00-04:30 (1.5h)
   - Total: 8 hours
   - Tolerance: 10min late, 5min early
   - GPS: None
   - Active: ✓

Week 4: Assign to Employees

IT Department (25 people):
- Schedule: Flexible Work Hours
- Effective: 01/06/2026
- Bulk assign via employee list

Sales Department (15 people):
- Schedule: Standard Office Hours
- Effective: 01/06/2026
- Assign individually or bulk

Warehouse (30 people):
- Schedule: Early Morning Shift
- Effective: 01/06/2026
- GPS enabled, coordinate with location

Customer Service (40 people):
- Schedule: Afternoon Shift (20 people)
- Schedule: Night Shift (20 people)
- Effective: 01/06/2026
- Shift rotation setup in HR

Management (5 people):
- Schedule: Flexible Work Hours
- Effective: 01/06/2026

Total: 115 employees assigned to appropriate schedules

---

RESULT:
- Clear work schedules for all departments
- Attendance tracking configured
- GPS validation for warehouse
- Flexible policy for IT/management
- Shift coverage for customer service
- Ready for attendance enforcement

items.title: Skenario 2: Troubleshoot Attendance Issue
items.body:
Ahmad = warehouse staff, early shift schedule (05:00-14:00) with GPS validation.
Problem: Ahmad consistently fails GPS check-in despite being at warehouse.

Investigasi:

1. Check Ahmad's Schedule:
   - Schedule: "Early Morning Shift"
   - GPS Required: Yes
   - GPS Radius: 100 meters
   - Office GPS: -6.2850, 107.0100 (Bandung warehouse)

2. Check Failed Check-ins:
   - Date: 01/05/2026, 05:15 AM
   - Status: FAILED_GPS_VALIDATION
   - Error: "You are 150 meters away from office"
   - Ahmad's reported location: 50 meters from warehouse (but system shows 150m)

3. Root Cause Analysis:
   - GPS accuracy issue (GPS can be ±30m inaccurate)
   - Warehouse building might block GPS signal
   - Ahmad checking in from parking lot (actually further)
   - Warehouse coordinate in system might be slightly off

4. Solutions:

   Option A: Increase GPS Radius
   - Current: 100 meters
   - Change to: 200 meters
   - Covers warehouse + parking area
   - Edit schedule → GPS Radius = 200m
   - Impact: Slightly less strict, but solves problem

   Option B: Verify GPS Coordinates
   - Recheck warehouse GPS using Google Maps
   - Current: -6.2850, 107.0100
   - Actual: -6.28523, 107.01012 (slightly different)
   - Update coordinates with better accuracy
   - Retest with Ahmad

   Option C: WiFi-based Location (if supported)
   - GPS unreliable in warehouse
   - Use WiFi authentication instead
   - Connect to warehouse WiFi = check-in location valid
   - Less GPS-dependent

   Option D: Fallback Mechanism
   - If GPS fails, allow manual verification
   - Manager/supervisor can approve check-in
   - Used for GPS-problematic locations

5. Implementation:
   - Choose Option A + B (safest)
   - Increase radius to 150m
   - Verify & update GPS coordinates to match actual location
   - Test with Ahmad: 05:15 check-in again → Should now pass
   - Monitor for 1 week

6. Prevention:
   - Document warehouse as "GPS problematic location"
   - Set reminder to test location quarterly
   - Brief employees on GPS requirements
   - Provide troubleshooting guide

---

RESULT:
- Ahmad's check-in issue resolved
- GPS validation working correctly
- 150m radius appropriate for location
- Future prevented with better coordinates

items.title: Pertanyaan Umum
items.body:
Q: Apa bedanya fixed dan flexible hours?
A: Fixed = jam masuk & pulang tetap (08:00-17:00). Flexible = range jam masuk (07:00-10:00 start), tapi total jam tetap sama (8 jam). Gunakan flexible untuk remote/hybrid work, fixed untuk office-based.

Q: Berapa tolerance yang ideal?
A: Standard 10-15 menit late, 5-10 menit early leave. Tergantung culture & industry. Finance/admin lebih ketat (5 min), IT/creative lebih loose (15-20 min).

Q: GPS tidak akurat, apa solusi?
A: Increase radius (dari 100m ke 150-200m). Verify GPS coordinates di Google Maps. Update if different. Test location. Consider WiFi-based if GPS problematic.

Q: Bisa punya multiple breaks?
A: Ya, system support multiple breaks. Contoh: 12:00-13:00 (lunch) + 15:00-15:15 (coffee break). Total breaks dikurangi dari working hours.

Q: Gimana cara change schedule untuk employee?
A: Edit employee record → Work Schedule section → Change Schedule → Select new schedule + effective date → Save. Effective date determines kapan schedule change applies.

Q: Bisa assign schedule ke department sekaligus?
A: Tergantung system. Jika ada bulk operation: select department + action "assign schedule" + effective date → apply to all. Atau assign individually.

Q: Schedule bisa di-share across companies?
A: Schedule independent per company typically. Jika multi-company, create schedule di each company, atau jika system allow, flag as "global" & reuse. Check system configuration.

Q: Apa terjadi jika change schedule di tengah bulan?
A: New schedule applies dari effective date onwards. Attendance tracking uses new schedule untuk validation. History kept for audit. Recommend change di awal bulan untuk clarity.

items.title: Best Practices
items.body:
1. CLEAR NAMING
   ✓ "Standard Office Hours" not "Schedule A"
   ✓ "Flexible Engineering Hours" clear
   ✓ Include key info in name (if possible)

2. REASONABLE TOLERANCE
   ✓ Not too strict (10-15 min typical)
   ✓ Not too loose (>30 min defeats purpose)
   ✓ Match company culture

3. BREAK TIME REALISTIC
   ✓ Include lunch (1 hour)
   ✓ Include prayer breaks (if applicable)
   ✓ 15-30 min afternoon break
   ✓ Total breaks: 1.5-2 hours for 8h day

4. GPS CONFIGURATION
   ✓ Test location before rolling out
   ✓ Set reasonable radius (100-200m)
   ✓ Document GPS requirements in policy
   ✓ Provide fallback for GPS failures

5. FLEXIBILITY
   ✓ Support multiple schedules
   ✓ Easy to change (not locked forever)
   ✓ Track history (for audit)
   ✓ Effective date clear

6. COMMUNICATION
   ✓ Announce new schedules to employees
   ✓ Explain grace periods/tolerance
   ✓ Clarify GPS requirements (if any)
   ✓ Provide guide for clock-in/out

7. TESTING
   ✓ Test schedule before rollout
   ✓ Sample employees test check-in
   ✓ Verify tolerance calculation
   ✓ GPS validation works
   ✓ All breaks calculated correctly

8. MONITORING
   ✓ Review tolerance exceptions (too many lates?)
   ✓ Check GPS failures (location issue?)
   ✓ Adjust tolerance if needed
   ✓ Annual review of schedules
